mistakes.title: Thermal pad not connected
mistakes.explanation: U1 has an exposed thermal pad (pad 9) that is not connected to any net. Thermal pads must be connected to ground with multiple vias for heat dissipation. Unconnected thermal pads cause device overheating and failure.
mistakes.fix_suggestion: Connect the thermal pad on U1 to ground (GND). Add a copper pour under the pad with 4-9 thermal vias connecting to the ground plane.
